title: Regular users can create agents in Microsoft Entra from 4 November 2026 unless you opt out
summary: Microsoft Entra is adding a default user permission called 'Users can create agent blueprints'. From 4 November 2026, with rollout continuing through late November, users without an admin role can create agent identity blueprints and the agents built from them unless the setting is turned off.
why: Agents can act with their own identity and permissions. Letting every user create them makes it harder to keep track of what exists and who owns it.
todo: Set 'Users can create agent blueprints' to No if you want to control agent creation.
Give named builders the Agent ID Developer role instead.
Review blueprint owners regularly, because owners can create agents from their blueprints.
